name: Dutch ADE Detection Benchmark
description: An evaluation suite of Dutch free-text hospital documents for benchmarking transformer-based models on adverse drug event detection.
reputation: Niche but respected within Dutch clinical NLP and pharmacovigilance research; used in domain-specific model evaluations in the Netherlands.
notes: Domain-specific (Dutch clinical) data; relatively small and specialized dataset with de-identified hospital notes; risk of dataset contamination for models pretrained on Dutch clinical corpora; not a general-purpose LLM benchmark.
